source.title: Lurgan Mail, 29 May 1964, p. 28 ("Rural District of Moira: notice of result of elections, 1964")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the no-election report read in the Lurgan Mail of 22 May 1964.

note: Triennial election of Moira Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was no contest. Six divisions were filled; Clare was entered blank in the notice of result because no candidate was nominated, and the division is therefore left unrepresented in this record. The council's clerk explained that when no nomination was received the seat had to be offered to the member who held it for the preceding term; Clare's member, J. Wilson, had been returned for Bleary instead and could not hold two seats, so Clare stayed vacant (Lurgan Mail, 22 May 1964, p. 18). It was filled at a casual-vacancy election in July 1964, when David J. Robinson, the only nominee, was declared elected (Lurgan Mail, 24 July 1964, pp. 27 and 30): a by-election, not part of this round (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
